story: An ancient legend has long been passed down in the Silverglow Kingdom: whenever the moonlight is tainted by the Black Breath, the guardian sleeping within the Sacred Laurel Forest will awaken. Artemis is the legendary Goddess of the Moon Hunt. During the War of the Gods, she exhausted her divine power to protect the ancestors of the elves, and her shattered divinity caused her to lose most of her memories. When she awakened again, she still possessed the divine bow capable of commanding moonlight and tracking prey, but had become a mischievous, cheerful girl who frequently forgot things. When the Black Breath began searching for the fragments of her divinity scattered across the continent, Artemis eagerly set out on her journey. She would forget maps, names, and the details of her missions, so she had no choice but to carve important promises into the fletching of her arrows. Even so, she never forgot to protect the weak, for while the body may forget, her divine nature always remembers where the arrow should fly.

story: The oldest military banner of the Varen Federation has always borne the image of Athena holding a spear and raising a shield. Before she was revered as the Goddess of War and Guardianship, she was a human commander. At the beginning of the Shard Era, she led the survivors in rebuilding their city-state, quelled disputes with unwavering resolve, and defended the city gate alone for seven days when the Black Breath army laid siege to the city. In the final battle, Athena used her own body to withstand the power of an out-of-control Dragon Breath crystal. In response to her conviction to protect everyone, the Dragon Breath coalesced into an immortal divinity, forging the Sunwheel Sacred Shield and the Spear of Judgment. From then on, she became a symbol of order and courage for humanity. Now, as the Black Breath spreads once more, the war drums long silent within the temple resound again. Athena personally takes to the battlefield, uniting the allied forces with her dignified authority and inspiring her companions with unreserved passion. She firmly believes that true gods should not sit high above the heavens, but stand before the people.

story: Deka Chiyan was born in the "Red Card Village" of the Dragon Breath Continent, a village famous for its unique fiery red soil. However, the village was often tormented by evil forces, causing great suffering to the villagers. When Deka Chiyan was still young, his family was attacked, and his parents tragically died protecting him. After that event, Deka Chiyan vowed to become strong. During his growth, he trained alone, practiced assassin skills, and gained much knowledge from an ancient book. This book is considered a treasured heritage passed down by the village, containing wisdom about survival and assassination. Through continuous effort, he not only improved his strength but also gradually developed a unique understanding of the essence of life. To avenge his family and protect the innocent, Deka Chiyan embarked on an adventure seeking justice. Along the way, he fought while exploring and helped solve various challenges in complex situations, becoming a well-respected assassin. His new goal is to destroy the dark forces that threaten the safety of the village and strive to rebuild the home he once lost.

story: Lia is a young elf full of vitality from the core area of the Sacred Forest known as the "Heart of the Mother Tree" in the eastern part of the Dragon Breath continent. Her body seems made of new buds and petals, wearing a small white flower on her head, with green, waterfall-like hair resembling entwined branches and leaves. Her soul is deeply connected with nature, able to sense the forest's breath and subtle changes. She is not an ordinary member of the plant race but the embodiment of the "Flower of Life," an extremely rare life entity containing powerful purification and regeneration abilities. After the Dragon Breath source was shattered, Dark Breath continuously corrupted the land, causing ecological imbalance and endless calamities, plunging many plant clans into crisis. Lia grew up in the Sacred Forest Academy and was specially trained by the Plant Race Council as a "Purification Envoy," bearing the heavy responsibility of healing the polluted land and her companions with the power of life. Though still young, her pure and kind nature has earned her the trust of the council and many clanspeople. Lia travels the borders of various tribes, dedicated to stopping the spread of Dark Breath. Her healing magic not only heals wounds but can also purify Dragon Breath crystals polluted by Dark Breath, restoring some of their energy and order. Whenever she appears on the battlefield's edge, many desperate lives are reborn; her presence is like the first breeze of spring after the winter snow melts.

story: Livia was born in one of the darkest fissures of the Dragon Breath continent, a barren land deeply irradiated by Dark Breath crystals and corrupted by demonic magic. She is a powerful member of the Dark Breath clan and a young yet immensely potential fire magic master within the demon faction. Her name “Flame Shadow” derives from the fiercely purple-red flames she controls, which both consume everything and resemble mysterious, deadly ghost fires in the night. During her early years, Livia underwent harsh indoctrination and trials in the chaotic lands surged by Dark Breath, swiftly mastering the chaotic power of fire, and climbing the demon ranks with ruthlessness and cunning. She is capable and confident but harbors an ambition capable of overturning the reality of the Valen continent—using the power of Dark Breath and fire to reshape the continental order and usher the demon race into a new glorious era. Livia is not a mere destroyer; she understands the importance and potential of the Dragon Breath crystals and seeks to strengthen herself by seizing and corrupting them, secretly manipulating conflicts among humans, orcs, and the plant race to fulfill her goals. She maintains close ties with high-ranking demon cult leaders and secretly trades forbidden spells with a few fallen dragon remnants. In a crucial battle, Livia faced off against the human Grom “Frenzied Axe” and plant race Lia. The clash of flame and life, order and chaos, has drawn the attention of multiple races on the continent. Though her path is shrouded in darkness, some glimpse the unfathomable wisdom and strategic insight behind her.

story: Mitia was born in the most secretive tribe of the Rift Clans, the “Shadow Claw Huntress,” renowned for their agility and stealth. They use keen senses and covert skills to navigate the dangerous territories of the Rift, hunting enemies and monsters. As the youngest and most outstanding assassin in her tribe, she is clever and alert, adept at using terrain and shadows to conceal her movements, roaming the ruins and wilderness of the Storm Rift. Her blades are mostly shadow daggers and light weapons, wielded with extreme speed and lethality, often felling enemies before they can react. Her playful curiosity leads her to take risks in perilous environments, but her decisiveness and coldness earn her the reverence of some elders. Mitia once accepted secret orders from the orc leader “Lord of Frenzied Breath” to infiltrate enemy camps and gather intelligence on Dragon Breath crystals, completing numerous high-risk assassination and sabotage missions. She moves fluidly among various factions, sometimes a phantom killer in wars, other times a guardian of the Rift Clans. Occasionally, she forms alliances with human adventurers and plant race scouts to carry out covert operations.

Because where Dragon's Breath fragments scatter, fire elements often harbor massive destructive power. Mia hopes to harness it rather than be consumed, avoiding repeating the ancient gods' war disasters.

She traverses the battlefield, calming the raging spiritual entities with the vibrations of her meditation staff and transforming chaotic demonic energy into healing vitality. To her allies, she is a gentle redeemer; to the demons, she is an insurmountable spiritual barrier.

Often teaming up with humans and the plant race, she uses the power of ice and frost to create protective barriers and control the battlefield. Beneath her gentle appearance lies resilience and determination; she believes that only peace and purity can dispel the darkness and turmoil of the Dragon Breath continent.

Born into a famous human mage family, her mischievous nature often led her to use transformation magic to prank peers, causing both headaches and affection from academy mentors. Despite her playful exterior, Lia possesses exceptional talent in control magic, precisely manipulating sheep transformation effects and even rapidly switching enemy forms in multi-target battles, plunging foes into confusion and sluggishness. She excels in exploiting enemy underestimation to turn battles around at critical moments. The fierce conflicts of the Dragon's Breath Fragment era made Lia realize mere tricks are insufficient for severe challenges. She began deep study of transformation magic's deeper mysteries, aspiring to become an important strategic mage influencing battle results.

story: On the edge of the wastelands and canyons south of the Dragon Breath Continent, lives a group of dwarf outcasts who prefer taming beasts over mining. Peggy is the best among them. Unlike her kin who spend all day at underground forges, Peggy prefers galloping across the sun-drenched red earth. Her mount is a mutated tusked boar named "Big Tooth," a cub she rescued during a Dragon Breath storm. The innate toughness of a dwarf combined with the boar's brute force has made Peggy the most troublesome "Patrol" for the demons in the canyon region. Her double-edged axe, roughly ground from hard Dragon Breath ore, is not ornate but sharp enough to cleave through the thickest demon shells. Though she lacks complex magical arts, her never-retreating drive and pure bond with beasts have seen her through many skirmishes. She is the Red Cyclone of the wilderness and the most restless soul of the Iron Hammer Clan.

story: Starstreak hails from the Varn Federation's oldest temple academy, "Lightbringer Academy." As a descendant of the Holy Page Weavers, she has received rigorous training in runes and holy light magic since childhood, mastering spells of blessing and protection. Holding a holy scripture inlaid with Dragon Breath crystals, she weaves holy light and runic power into an invisible web of protection, building an indestructible defensive barrier for her allies. In the turbulent era of Dragon Breath shards, Starstreak chose to join the ranks of priests, driven not only by her reverence for life but also by a sense of duty to protect every inch of land eroded by Black Breath and her wounded compatriots. She embodies the union of reason and faith, serving as both a guardian of wisdom and an indispensable aide on the battlefield. Beneath Lightbringer Academy lie ancient Dragon Breath runic inscriptions; Starstreak dedicates herself to studying their mysteries, seeking to unlock more secrets of the crystals' power. She believes that through the purification of holy light, sealed ancient powers can be awakened to restore order and balance to the continent. Serene and steadfast, she often uses detailed runic weaving rituals to cast protection, heal wounds, and dispel shadows for her teammates. She is not only a spiritual pillar but also a resolute shield against the corruption of Black Breath. Whether in the high towers of the Runic City or amidst rain-swept ruins, she always walks the edge of the scientific and the divine, lighting the path for human warriors. Her story is etched with humanity's endless thirst for redemption and hope, an epic chapter where the brilliance of reason intertwines with the veins of magic.
